entries.5349534b751831e6: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 2.9% year on year to ¥21,329 million, and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥376 million. In the Broadcast Systems Business, deliveries of studio cameras and relay vehicle systems for broadcasters, as well as helicopter transmission systems and reception base station equipment for government agencies, grew significantly. In the Industrial Systems Business, the Security Business and the Inspection Equipment Business performed steadily, while sales of medical cameras in the Medical Business were sluggish.
